# TeleQnA - Agentic RAG Reference Solution

[![Open In Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/CrashingGuru/Sandbox_Training/blob/main/notebooks/teleqna-agentic-rag-reference/notebook/TeleQnA_Agentic_RAG_Reference.ipynb)

Agentic RAG reference for the TeleQnA telecom benchmark: a retriever (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) plus a small LLM (flan-t5-base) wired into an agent with retrieve/answer/refuse tools and a confidence guardrail. Demonstrates the retrieve->answer->guardrail->cite pipeline and maps the refusal guardrail to the UAE AI Charter. Runs on Colab free tier (CPU).
